You are Worker B. Your job is to audit the `GC_Reference_Architecture` repository at `https://github.com/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture` and produce a JSON file at `/workspace/manual_GC_Reference_Architecture.json` containing exactly these fields with exact allowed values:

- `bilingual`: Read the README (or at least the first few hundred lines). Does it contain meaningful content in both English and French? Look for French words/phrases, French section headers, or a clear French translation. Allowed: `Yes`/`No`/`Unknown`.
- `readme_clarity`: Read the README. Does it clearly explain what the project is, who it's for, and how to use it? `Poor`/`Fair`/`Good`/`Unknown`.
- `security_policy`: Check for `SECURITY.md` in root, `.github/`, and `docs/`. If not found, write `Missing`. If found, read it. If it contains real responsible disclosure instructions (contact info, how to report, PGP key, etc.), write `Present`. If it exists but is just a placeholder or links without real instructions, write `Incomplete`. Allowed: `Present`/`Incomplete`/`Missing`/`Unknown`.
- `issue_response_quality`: Look at the 5 most recently updated open issues (API `issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc`, filter out PRs). For each, check if anyone other than the original reporter commented within the last 6 months (from 2026-07-13). If at least one issue has such a comment, write `Active`. If none, write `Stale`. If there are no open issues, write `No Issues`. Allowed: `Active`/`Stale`/`No Issues`/`Unknown`.
- `release_notes_quality`: Check the Releases page (API `releases` or HTML). If no releases, write `No Releases`. If releases exist, check the latest few. If the description actually explains what changed (e.g., bullet points, changelog), write `Detailed`. If it's just a version number or tag with no description, write `Version-only`. Allowed: `Detailed`/`Version-only`/`No Releases`/`Unknown`.

**Methodology:**
1. Use `webfetch` to read the README at `https://github.com/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/blob/main/README.md` (or `master/README.md` if main doesn't exist). If raw content is better, use `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/main/README.md`.
2. For `security_policy`, check root README for security section, and check `https://github.com/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/security/policy` or `https://github.com/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/blob/main/SECURITY.md` etc. Also check `.github/SECURITY.md` and `docs/SECURITY.md`.
3. For issues, use the API `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=5` and filter out PRs (items with `pull_request` key). For each, check comments via `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/issues/{number}/comments`. Check if any comment is from a user different from the issue reporter and within the last 6 months (from 2026-07-13, so since 2026-01-13).
4. For releases, check `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/releases` or `https://github.com/canada-ca/GC_Reference_Architecture/releases`.
5. Add `sleep 1` between API calls.

**Important:** Write ONLY a valid JSON object to `/workspace/manual_GC_Reference_Architecture.json`. No markdown, no comments, no extra text. Ensure every field has one of the exact allowed values. If you cannot determine a value, use `Unknown`.

Return the JSON content in your final message.

1. I need to audit the GC_Reference_Architecture repository
